summary: Post-refactor regression run. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py into a comprehensive pytest suite (24 tests) covering every commit intent + undo, correction, dashboard/insights, weekly+monthly reports, purchases history, reminders, shopping list/restock, settings/suggest-target, brief + TTS cache, receipt vision, demo reset and error paths — 24/24 pass. Frontend (390x844 mobile): Home (talk panel, stats, target, shopping, brief, insights, trend, history+undo), chip-0 save (revenue 104k->191k), correction chip (hint + 'Perbaiki', 191k->201k i.e. 87k replaced by 97k), undo (201k->104k), Memori 6 tabs incl. Belanja purchase rows with negotiation hint, Piutang -> reminder sheet with AI message + Kirim WhatsApp, Laporan 7/30 hari toggle with comparison + breakdown + top items, and Mode Demo Juri progressing babak 2->6 automatically. Two frontend defects found (demo-mode duplicates the whole dataset; unguarded clipboard writes crash into the CRA error overlay).

minor.issue: comparison.revenue_delta/expense_delta/profit_delta are null because the 20-day seed has no data in the previous 30-day window, so share_text has no comparison line. Behaviour is correct but monthly comparison is effectively dead in the demo — consider seeding ~45-60 days or labelling 'belum ada data pembanding'.

ensure_seed() uses a non-atomic count-then-insert; two overlapping resets seed the dataset twice (see frontend HIGH issue). Needs an asyncio lock / idempotency guard (e.g. unique seed marker doc) so a duplicate call cannot double-insert.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is awaited without try/catch. When clipboard permission is denied (headless browser, iOS Safari, non-secure context) the rejection is unhandled and CRA shows a full-screen 'Uncaught runtime errors: NotAllowedError ... Write permission denied' overlay that blocks the whole app. Reproduced by clicking report-copy-btn and shopping-copy-btn.

integration_issues.issue: Opening the Demo tour DOUBLES the entire demo dataset: sales 49->99, expenses 8->16, customers 4->8, receivables 3->6, inventory 6->12 (reproduced deterministically; backend log prints 'Demo data seeded' twice). Cause: DemoTour.jsx:119 calls resetDemo() inside an effect that React StrictMode invokes twice, and server ensure_seed()'s count-then-insert races, so both calls insert a full copy. Visible symptoms: duplicate inventory rows on Stok, duplicate/identical reminder cards in babak 6 (same Pak Budi twice instead of Pak Budi + Mbak Rina), doubled revenue/report numbers. Fix on both sides: guard the effect (useRef/once) AND make seeding atomic/idempotent.

action_items: Guard DemoTour's resetDemo() effect against StrictMode double-invocation and make backend ensure_seed()/demo reset idempotent (lock or seed-marker) — demo mode currently corrupts the dataset it is meant to showcase.

Wrap all navigator.clipboard.writeText calls (Report.jsx:24, ShoppingCard.jsx:32, ReminderSheet.jsx:35) in try/catch with a toast fallback so denied clipboard permission cannot surface the runtime-error overlay.
Optional: extend seed to >30 days (or show 'belum ada pembanding') so the monthly report comparison deltas are not null.
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_seed(): 'if count_documents == 0: insert_many' is a check-then-act race; two concurrent /api/demo/reset calls each insert a full dataset. Use an asyncio.Lock plus an upsert-guard doc in a 'meta' collection.
revert_ops() blindly replays stored ops; it does not verify the doc still exists/was not changed since. Acceptable for a demo, but an undo after a later edit can silently restore stale values.
server.py is 1104 lines — reports/purchases/nlu-commit blocks are good candidates for separate routers now that handlers are already extracted.

Refactor itself is behaviour-preserving: sales use _adjust_inventory(create_missing=False) (verified no inventory doc created for menu names), expense add_to_inventory creates/increments, inventory commit sets absolute qty, and every undo restored exact prior values.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows work; 2 defects: demo-mode data duplication, clipboard crash overlay)

seed_data_creation: Used /api/demo/reset before and after the suite; transient TEST_-prefixed customers/receivables/inventory items were created and all undone/removed. Final state: clean 20-day demo dataset (sales 49, receivables 3, inventory 6).
test_credentials: None required (no auth). /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but is not needed for this app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is a single pytest module (loadscope => one xdist worker) and mutates shared demo state sequentially — keep it as one module and do not split into classes. It resets demo data at module start and end. Frontend must be tested at 390x844. brief-refresh-btn works fine when scrolled into view and clicked normally (no force click needed) — the earlier 'tab flipped to Memori' report did not reproduce. After fixes, re-verify: (1) opening Demo tour keeps counts identical (sales 49 / receivables 3 / inventory 6 after reset), (2) copy buttons show a toast instead of the CRA error overlay.
rca_of_the_issue: Demo duplication: DemoTour.jsx line 119 fires resetDemo() in a mount effect; React 18 StrictMode runs mount effects twice in dev, so two /api/demo/reset requests overlap. Server reset deletes collections then calls ensure_seed(), whose 'sales count == 0' check is evaluated by both requests before either insert_many completes, so demo_data() is inserted twice. Clipboard crash: async copy handlers await navigator.clipboard.writeText without try/catch; a NotAllowedError becomes an unhandled promise rejection that react-error-overlay renders full-screen.
